**Issue #2975 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2975: Patch: a hand card the game won't let you play always says why, and the fuzz holds every card to it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a card in your hand cannot be played, the game says why (not enough mana, no open lane, no legal target). There is a gap. A card that needs a target can have, as its only target, an enemy that costs two discards to target (Paul Allen's Ghost) while you hold too few other cards. That card cannot be played and says nothing, so it simply does nothing when clicked, which is the very bug the explanation was added to fix. Once built, such a card gives its reason, and the random-game checker verifies on every turn that each unplayable hand card has one, so a later rule cannot silently reopen the gap.

## Why
- R979000: `playReason` is on the viewer's hand card while they may act and `legalActions` lists no play of it.
- `crates/engine/src/view_for.rs:684-689` sets it only when `why_hand_card_unplayable` returns a non-empty reason. `why_unplayable` (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:2071-2199`) ends with step (e), which asks only whether the unfiltered `play_choice_combinations(...)` is empty and otherwise returns `None`.
- The listing is narrower: `payable_play_choices` (`play_choices.rs:2423-2438`) drops every combination whose targeting discards cannot be paid (C #89, R682), and R123's tribute agreement (`play_choices.rs:2377`) drops more. Neither is modelled in the reason.
- Only hand-built cases test it (`crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs`), and no fuzz monitor check reads `playReason`.

## Proposal
- `why_unplayable`'s last step reads the same payable filter and tribute agreement the listing does, and returns that refusal's message (`why_targeting_discards_unpayable`'s) rather than `None`.
- A new fuzz monitor invariant, the next free I-number: while the viewer may act (R979000's window), each own hand card, and each graveyard card a permission lets them play (R1571000), carries `playReason` exactly when the legal list holds no play of it. It reuses the view and legal list I6 already builds (`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs:2541-2548`), so it costs almost nothing. The tutorial seat's `barred_from_play` is exempted if it needs to be.

## Where it lands
`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`, `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs` (or the tests of `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c089_paul_allens_ghost.rs`), the invariant list in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`'s header; SPEC §10.8.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test named after R979000: a required-target Spell in hand whose only target is an enemy Paul Allen's Ghost, with one other card held, has no listed play and a `playReason` naming the discard. It fails today.
- [ ] A monitor test reports the new invariant on that state before the fix and nothing after.
- [ ] The 200-seed fuzz gate (`cargo jackioh fuzz`) passes with the new check; any further card it finds without a reason gets one.
- [ ] No state, event or replay hash changes (presentation only, CLAUDE.md rule 7); `cargo jackioh golden check` passes.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 4 files, 100 to 150 lines. The new check may turn up other fall-throughs, each needing a reason; that is the point, but it can grow the patch.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41758658464)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Close the `playReason` gap from issue #2975: a hand card whose only plays die in the targeting-discard filter (C #89 Paul Allen's Ghost, R682) or the R123 tribute-agreement filter says nothing today, though `legalActions` lists no play of it. After the patch, `why_unplayable` models both filters and returns the reducer's own refusal words, and a new fuzz-monitor invariant (I13, the next free I-number) asserts on every sampled turn that each unplayable own hand/graveyard card carries `playReason` exactly when no play of it is listed. A new ruling, R2975000 (block R2975000–R2975999 is free), records the decision and amends R979000, whose note currently documents the silence.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` | change | `why_unplayable` steps (f)+(g); extract R123-refusal helper from `why_choices_refused` |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | change | I13 header entry; `play_reason_violations` free fn; `InvariantMonitor::play_reason` method |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs` | change | `r979000_r2975000_*` Ghost test + I13 monitor test |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | header `I1–I12` → `I1–I13` + I13 line; call `monitor.play_reason` beside both `monitor.hidden` calls |
| `spec/rulings/R2975000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/2975.md` | new | §11 paragraph for the ruling |
| `spec/10-engine-guide.md` | change | one sentence + `[[R2975000]]` in the §10.8 `playReason` paragraph |
| `spec/rulings/R979000.md` | change | fix the "say nothing" sentence to point at R2975000 |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `apps/web/` (its `playReason.test.tsx` has no Ghost case); wire types (`CardView.play_reason` already exists); any `config.rs` (no new numbers — every message reuses an existing refusal); the catalog. Governing spec: §10.5 steps 1–2, §10.8 `playReason` paragraph, §9.1; rulings R979000, R1571000, R682, R123, R703.

## Steps

1. **Reproduce first.** In `crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs`, add `r979000_r2975000_ghost_targeting_cost_says_the_discard` in a new `mod r979000_r2975000_targeting_cost_says_why`: start from `playing("r2975000-ghost")`, clear p1's hand (`state.players.p1.hand.clear()`), `put(&mut state, "classic-089", slot(PlayerId::P2, Row::Units, 1), json!({}))` so the enemy Ghost is the only unit on either board, then `in_hand` the existing `needed()` spell plus one filler (`grave_spell()`). Assert `plays_of` the spell is empty and `reason_of` is `Some("targeting that costs 2 discards, and you hold 1 card")`. Run it; it must fail (no reason today). Copy the assertion helpers (`reason_of`, `has_no_plays`) already in the file.
2. **Fix `why_unplayable`** (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:2161-2200`), keeping steps (a)–(e) untouched. After step (e)'s `is_empty` branch, add step (f): `let payable = payable_play_choices(state, player, card, &face);` if empty, return the first combination's discard refusal — compute `owed = targeting_discards_required(state, player, &face, targets, modes, None)` for the first entry of `play_choice_combinations(state, player, &face, None)` and return `why_targeting_discards_unpayable(state, player, owed, &play_uses(card, targets))`'s message (it is `Err` for every combo here by construction; take the first `Err`). Then step (g): if `declares_bound_tribute(state, &face)` holds and no `payable` choice's targets/modes satisfy `tribute_picks_agree` for any set in `tribute_sets`, return the R123 refusal. Extract that one-line format from `why_choices_refused` into a helper (e.g. `refuse_tribute_disagreement(state, &face)`) and call it from both places, so the words cannot drift.
3. **Probe the tutorial bar.** With a `barred_from_play` seat (tutorial-only cards in hand), print what `why_hand_card_unplayable` returns today. If it is `None` while `play_actions_for` is empty, the invariant (step 5) skips cards where `barred_from_play(state, player, card)` holds; do not add a reason for barred cards — out of scope.
4. **Add I13** in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`. Document it in the header check list beside I6: I13 every unplayable own hand card (R979000) and every admitted own graveyard card (R1571000) carries `playReason` exactly when the legal list holds no play of it (§10.8). Add free fn `play_reason_violations(state, viewer, view, legal)`: return empty unless the R979000 window holds exactly as `with_play_reason` gates it (`result` none, `phase == Main`, `pending` none, `active == viewer`); for each card in `view.you.hand` (`HandView::Cards`) with `listed = legal` holding a `Play` of its id, report `I13 … (§10.8, R979000)` when `listed == play_reason.is_some()`; same over `view.you.graveyard` citing R1571000, but only for cards `playable_from_graveyard` admits, and require `play_reason` absent on unadmitted ones; skip step-3-barred cards. Add `InvariantMonitor::play_reason(&self, state)` mirroring `hidden()` (`:2539-2569`): per viewer, one `catch_unwind` building `view_for` + `legal_actions` once, then both checks.
5. **Wire the fuzz.** In `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`: header `I1–I12` → `I1–I13` with a one-line I13 description; extend the two `monitor.hidden(&state)` call sites (setup opening, on-stride loop) with `monitor.play_reason(&state)` at the same stride — no new stride constant.
6. **Monitor test.** In `play_reason.rs`, add `r2975000_monitor_reports_a_reasonless_card`: build the step-1 Ghost state, assert the new `play_reason_violations`/`play_reason` is non-empty with the fix reverted (verify once via `git stash` of only `play_choices.rs`, then restore), and empty after the fix. Keep both tests' names carrying the `r2975000` underscore-token (and `r979000`).
7. **Spec.** Write `spec/rulings/R2975000.md` (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards: "§10.5, §10.8, C #89, R682, R123, R979000"`, `proven_in: [crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs]`): targeting-discard and tribute-agreement fall-throughs say the reducer's refusal, ordered as the listing filters (discards, then tribute agreement), amending R979000's "say nothing" sentence. Write `spec/pending/2975.md` with the `**[[R2975000]] … (issue #2975, 2026-11-04)**: …` paragraph. In `spec/10-engine-guide.md`'s `playReason` paragraph, extend the fixed-order list with the targeting-cost case linking `[[R2975000]]`. In `spec/rulings/R979000.md`, narrow the "say nothing" sentence to the Equip case and link `[[R2975000]]` for targeting costs.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules_2 r2975000` — the two new tests (file `crates/engine/tests/rules/play_reason.rs`, binary `rules_2` via `mod_2.rs`).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules_2 play_reason` and `--test rules graveyard_play_reason` + `invariants` — no regressions in neighbouring reason/monitor tests.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit invariants` — lib-level monitor tests.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --cards classic-089 --seeds 20` — local signal with the Ghost forced into decks (the 200-seed gate itself runs in CI).
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh golden check`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Done when

- [ ] Ghost test fails before the `play_choices.rs` fix, passes after; monitor test reports on the reverted state and is clean after.
- [ ] Small forced-card fuzz run passes; any further reasonless card it surfaces gets the reducer's refusal words too.
- [ ] `spec check` passes (R2975000 note, test names, `[[…]]` links, pending file); `golden check` passes (view-only change, no state/event/replay hash move).
- [ ] fmt, clippy, and the neighbouring reason/invariant test files are green.

## Risks

- **More fall-throughs.** I13 may find other listed-empty/reasonless cases (Cloaked face-down pricing, Mayor R1200, X/embiggen edges). Give each the reducer's existing refusal words; invent no new sentence. If one has no refusal at all, report it rather than wording one.
- **Tribute-agreement message wording.** It must stay byte-identical to `why_choices_refused`'s — hence the shared helper, not a copy.
- **Hidden information.** Reasons name only the viewer's card, public prices/zones/counts (R979000's rule); the discard message names counts only — safe.
- **Duos.** I13 is not added to the Duos monitor (out of scope); duels' 1v1 states still get it through the gate's per-game monitor.

## Open questions

None — every choice above follows the issue's proposal or the repo's conventions. If the tutorial-bar probe (step 3) shows barred cards already carry a reason, drop the exemption.
```
